FAQ

A few things before your shift.

Answers about the simulator, your controller and the job at the clock.

Which simulator should I choose?

Read the label on your console and compare its hockey insert with the reference images. Use the arena and panel finder. A matching brand or a code such as 871 alone does not identify every chassis.

How long are the periods?

Your league or tournament sets the format. Confirm period lengths, stop time versus running time, warm-up, timeouts and curfew before the game. The 15-minute practice default is not a rules recommendation.

Should a goal clear a penalty automatically?

No simulator clears one solely because a score changed. An eligible minor may terminate when the opposing team scores while it is shorthanded. Majors and coincidental penalties require different handling. Confirm the release with the official; see penalty basics.

Why are some buttons disabled?

These are training profiles. Hardware configuration menus, other sports, auxiliary equipment and some hockey functions remain outside specific profiles. Each simulator shows its unsupported control count and links to its limits. A disabled control is not a statement that the real device lacks it.

Why does the horn make no sound?

Tap Sound on and interact with the page to unlock browser audio. Check device volume, silent mode and browser sound permission. A visual horn response can still appear when sound is muted.

What is the difference between tutorials and Test yourself?

Tutorials show the button sequence. Test rounds use shuffled scenarios with variable clock targets, scores and player numbers. Revealing the solution or restarting marks the task assisted; skips appear in the review.

Can I connect this to the scoreboard at my rink?

No. These pages practise locally in the browser. They do not transmit commands to rink equipment.

Where are the manuals?

The manuals index separates manufacturer manuals, association-hosted copies and local quick guides. Manuals for researched but unplayable controllers are included too.

Is my arena listed with its current equipment?

Arena reports show their source date and match confidence. Equipment and inserts can change. Always check the installed model; a regional brand report is not an exact controller match.

Does every controller have a remote?

No. Seven profiles have playable documented accessories. Others have unverified compatibility or optional equipment outside the current training configuration. Do not substitute a handset from another family.

Do you save my scores or test results?

Practice and test results live in the current page session and reset on reload. The site does not require an account. See Privacy for hosting and external-link details.

How do I report a missing model or a problem?

Use the report composer to prepare a GitHub issue. Include a reproducible sequence, the model and a public manual or source. Reports are public once you submit them on GitHub.
